payload.name: Herding behavior in live streaming commerce
payload.fact: Real-time behavioral data in live streaming commerce shows that interactive peaks precede purchase peaks by 1–3 minutes.
payload.boundary: Young consumers in live streaming commerce

provenance.title: The influence of trust in streamers, price promotions and group interactions on young consumers’ herding behavior in live streaming commerce
provenance.quote_or_locus: Real-time behavioral data showing that interactive peaks precede purchase peaks by 1–3 min, which is consistent with an emotional contagion behavioral following pathway
